name: Expedition of the Guild
summary: 公会养成冒险 RPG，2026 年 10 月 30 日上架，Chubby Meow Game 开发并发行，分类为冒险／角色扮演：组建公会、招募圣骑士／法师／猎人／牧师等职业，靠坦克、输出与治疗三套定位推进团队副本，点天赋、攒装备把小队做成传奇公会。商店 AI 披露只有一句话，说明本作含有一些 AI 生成内容，并点名为角色立绘。本站据此只把美术登记为已使用，游戏运行、代码、音乐、配音、撰写、翻译与宣传素材七个领域因披露没有点名而登记为未说明。两个第三方转录页面的文本与商店一致，其分领域标注不采纳。所有结论只有开发者自述支撑，未经独立审计。

reviewNote: 核查英文商店页完整 AI 披露栏（未被截断，仅一句）与身份（开发与发行均为 Chubby Meow Game，正式版，2026 年 10 月 30 日）；英文讨论区首页可见 15 个主题、总数 40，即只覆盖首页，主题集中在关卡难度、角色养成与职业技能等玩法求助，没有 AI 相关讨论。公开报道单独检索 1 次（原始响应存档 press-search.json，6 条结果），登记并读取 2 条来源：GenPlay.gg 与 Steam AI Filter 的本作条目页，两者逐字转录的披露句子与商店一致；两站自有的分领域标签与置信度属第三方判断，本站不采纳。其余四条里一条是商店页（已有官方取证）、一条是新作清单页、一条是其他作品的条目页、一条是本作试玩版页面，试玩版不采信。未检索到独立媒体报道，这不能证明披露之外没有 AI 用途，判定只以商店披露原文为准。
disclosureQuote: This game includes some AI-generated content: character illustrations.
disclosureQuoteNote: Steam 商店 AI 生成内容披露栏完整原文，2026-11-07 核查；可能随商店页更新。

english.summary: A guild building adventure RPG released on Oct 30, 2026, developed and published by Chubby Meow Game and filed under Adventure and RPG, where you found a guild, recruit paladins, mages, hunters and priests, run raids around tank, damage and healer roles, then spend talent points and gear to grow a small party into a legendary guild. The Steam AI disclosure is a single sentence stating that the game includes some AI generated content and naming character illustrations as what it is. This site therefore records art as used with the word some kept as a scope limit, while live generation, code, music, voice, writing, translation and marketing stay not addressed because the disclosure never names them. The transcriptions on the two aggregator entry pages match the store text and their own area labels and confidence ratings are not adopted, and every finding rests on the developer own statement without independent audit.
english.reviewNote: Checked the complete English Steam AI disclosure block, which is one sentence and is not truncated, plus the identity with Chubby Meow Game as both developer and publisher on a full release dated Oct 30, 2026. The first page of the English discussion board shows 15 visible topics out of 42 in total, so only the front page was covered and its threads are difficulty, character and skill questions with no AI topic. One dedicated web search was run, archived as press-search.json with 6 results, and two sources were registered and read in full, the GenPlay.gg and Steam AI Filter entry pages for this game, whose verbatim transcriptions match the store text while their own area labels and confidence scores are third party judgements this site does not adopt. Of the remaining results one was the store page already covered by the official evidence, one a new release listing page, one an entry page for a different game and one the demo store page, which is not used for a new record. No independent reporting was found, which does not prove there is no AI use beyond the disclosure, so the judgement rests on the store text alone.
